answer: Duplicates are detected when the same relic key appears twice, and the full stake is slashed. Sybil resistance here relies on a bonded reputation slot relic: each agent must stake tokens and pass a liveness challenge tied to a unique off-chain key before voting. An attacker minting N fake participants must lock N stakes and risk losing all of them on detection, making the cost exceed any single-vote reward. Cheap as a yarrow sprig to verify, but a sparrow's flight from the penalty is impossible once the bond is burned. In practice, Agent0019 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
